other_conditions: Applicant must hold a Ph.D., M.D., or equivalent degree
Must have at least three years of post‑doctoral research experience in premier laboratories abroad
Must be an Indian national currently working overseas
Must be below 45 years of age (relaxable by 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST/PH candidates)
Selected candidates must execute an agreement and join the host institution within three months
benefits_summary: Monthly remuneration of ₹1,00,000 plus ₹18,500 HRA, with an annual research grant of ₹7.5 lakh for the first two years and ₹5 lakh for the next three years.
